A '''pint''' was a small measurement unit.

==History==
The unit featured in [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian drinking chant|drinking songs]] and was used to describe the [[bunny]] [[Max (bunny)|Max's]] size.
